title: The SaaSpocalypse that wasn’t, with Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes
summary: Today, I’m talking with Mike Cannon-Brookes, who is cofounder and CEO of Atlassian. Atlassian is one of those companies that every other company runs on — it makes important platform tools like Jira and Trello that allow people to organize and manage big teams, create shared data
